# Enum CurveParametricApproximationType

Defines the various types of curve parametric approximations.

###### Namespace: TopSolid.Kernel.Automating

###### Assembly: TopSolid.Kernel.Automating.dll

##### Syntax

```
[DataContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 10, 301, 180)]
public enum CurveParametricApproximationType
```

##### Remarks

This enum is available since v7.10.301.180.

### Fields 

|  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  ArcLength |  Parametric approximation sticks to arc length curve parametrization.  |  
 
|  Free |  Free parametric approximation.  |
